Sub: Promotion from LDC cadre to SSA under Seniority Quota by relaxing the
length of service as prescribed in Recruitment Rules -Regarding

Sir,

The detailfof sanctioned strength, in position and vacancy in each mode of
recruitment in accordance with existing Recruitment Rules to the post of Social Security
Assistant as on 01.01.2019 were called for from all field offices which has been compiled by
this office.

2 On examining the data received from field offices, a proposal for seeking relaxation
in the period of eligibility service for promotion to the post of Social Security Assistant in
Level 4 of the pay matrix in relaxation of Recruitment Rules was sent to chairman, CBT,
EPF for approval. Hon’ble Chairman, CBT, EPF has approved the proposal in respect of 21
LDCs who can appear in the departmental examination for promotion to SSA as per existing
rules (list enclosed).

3: It is, therefore, requested to take necessary action accordingly and forward the
compliance report in the matter within one month.

Yours faithfully
Enc: bp abeve

(S.C. Sharma)
Regional PF Commissioner-I (HRM-V)
